description: Header file defining the PersistentStoreImplementation class, which implements multiple store-related interfaces and manages notifications, storage operations, and limits within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: PersistentStoreImplementation
classes.description: Implements storage, notification, and limit interfaces for persistent storage management within the plugin.

classes.name: Store2Notification
classes.description: Inner class handling notifications for IStore2 scope changes, forwarding value changes to registered clients.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification client to receive store change events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification client from receiving store change events.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the store within DEVICE scope.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a given key within DEVICE scope.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key within DEVICE scope.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace within DEVICE scope.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value with TTL in the store within specified scope.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Gets a value and TTL within specified scope.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key within specified scope.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes a namespace within specified scope.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Retrieves keys within a namespace and scope.

methods.name: GetStorageSizes
methods.description: Retrieves storage sizes within a scope.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace.
